nodes.name: BankChurners
nodes.summary: Customer churn dataset with 10,127 records and 23 columns covering demographics, account relationships, credit usage, transaction behavior, churn labels, and classifier-derived fields. It supplies the source data for the training pipeline and dashboard upload workflow.
nodes.languageNotes: CSV rows use quoted categorical values and include both the Attrition_Flag target and two Naive Bayes classifier output columns.

nodes.name: CHANGELOG.md
nodes.summary: Release history covering foundation-model additions, the uv migration, model-family preprocessing split, sequential GPU serving, and churn-label and CUDA-memory fixes.

nodes.name: CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md
nodes.summary: Community participation policy defining expected behavior, prohibited conduct, reporting through GitHub Issues, and maintainer enforcement responsibilities.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Primary project guide for the customer-churn training pipeline and Streamlit dashboard, covering models, benchmark results, architecture, setup, reproducibility, Docker deployment, project structure, and licensing.

nodes.name: SECURITY.md
nodes.summary: Security policy identifying supported versions and the GitHub Issues process for reporting vulnerabilities, including impact, reproduction details, and maintainer response handling.

nodes.name: pyproject.toml
nodes.summary: Project metadata and uv-managed dependency configuration for the Python 3.13 churn application, including optional Mitra and TabFM groups, pinned TabFM source metadata, CUDA PyTorch index settings, and pytest configuration.
nodes.languageNotes: The TOML separates optional foundation-model dependencies from the core environment and pins the TabFM source revision for reproducibility.
